units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:4">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>ק׳ את היצועין</he> upset the couches.

<cite ref="Chullin 8a:10">Ḥull. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>מותר … מְקַלְקֵל הוא</he> it is permitted to slaughter with a knife belonging to idolatrous service, because slaughtering is doing damage (a living animal being more useful than a dead one).

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 13:3">Sabb. XIII, 3</cite> <he>כל המְקַלְקְלִין פטורין</he> all those who perform an act (on the Sabbath) by which they do ruin, are exempt (from sin-offering); <he>והמקלקל ע״מ לתקן וכ׳</he> but he that undoes a thing for the purpose of reconstructing it is guilty.

senses.gloss: (with or sub. מעשה = b. h. הִשְׁחִית) to be corrupt, to disgrace one’s self by immorality.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:6:10">Y. Taan. I, end, 64ᵈ</cite> <he>חם</he> … <he>קִילְקְלוּ מעשיהן</he> Ham, the dog, and the raven acted mischievously (by sexual connection in the ark, v.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 12a:4">R. Hash. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>ברותחין קלקלו וכ׳</he> with heat (of passion) they sinned, and with hot waters they were punished; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:3">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite>.

Tosef. Sot. II, 2 אפי׳ תְקַלְקֵל וכ׳, v. עָרַר; a. fr.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. VII, ed. Bub. note 69 קלקלתי, v. כִּלְכֵּל.]—Part. pass. מְקוּלְקָל; f. מְקוּלְקֶלֶת; pl. מְקוּלְקָלִים, מְקוּלְקָלִין; מְקוּלְקָלוֹת.

<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:2">M. Kat. I, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Moed Katan 2a:2">2ᵃ</cite>) <he>ומתקנין את המקולקלת</he> Y. a. Bab. ed. (Mish. <he>המקולקלות</he>, incorr.) and you may mend a channel that is out of order during the festive week.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39b:19">Snh. 39ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 5:7">Ez. V, 7</cite>) <he>כמתוקנין … כמק׳ שבהם עשיתן</he> you did not do according to the good usages among them, but according to their corrupt usages.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 109b">B. Bath. 109ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01419"><he>קַלְקָלָה</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (b. h.) to sharpen; trnsf. (cmp. חָדַד, שָׁנַן) to repeat, study.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:10:1">Koh. R. to X, 10</cite> <he>אם נקהה … קַלְקֵל עליו בחילך</he> if thy lesson is as tough to thee as iron (v. <cite ref="S00201"><he>קָהָה</he></cite>), and … none is on hand to explain it to thee, go over it studying with thy own strength.

senses.gloss: to be disarranged, ruined, spoiled. Y. Taan. IV, 68ᶜ bot. נִתְקַלְקְלוּ חשבונותיו וכ׳ his dates were disarranged, and he said, let this begin a new era; נתקלקלו לשעבר the dates were disarranged (confused) with regard to the events of the past, v. קִילְקוּל.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 3:6">Dem. III, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01098"><he>חָלַף</he></cite>. Y. Shek. VII, 50ᶜ <he>נִתְקַלְקְלָה צורתן</he> (not <he>נתקלקה</he>), v. <cite ref="R00252"><he>צוּרָה</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: (v. קָלָה I) to commit a nuisance, to collapse under the influence of corporal punishment.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 286">Sifré Deut. 286</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:14">Macc. III, 14</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Bekhorot 8a">Bekh. 8ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="S01415"><he>נתקלקל</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="S01355"><he>קָלַל</he></cite>.]
